units.function: Pure trust-boundary tests for worker-supplied provider spans through HostServices and the real capability-gated SDK handler.
units.dependencyDirection: Uses HostServices clamp/parse functions and SDK createHostClientHandlers while replacing only the final instrumentation sink.
units.keyDataModels: W3C traceparent, closed span names, low-cardinality attributes, numeric status and bounded worker timestamps.
units.lifecycle: Submits valid and malicious span payloads, validates capability denial/admission and inspects the exact sanitized recorder input.
units.testAssessment: All sixteen cases passed. The suite is unusually strong for a narrow untrusted telemetry boundary, though it omits rate/cardinality quotas, tracer failure and tenant/run ownership.
units.designRationale: Prevent commands, paths and standard-stream secrets from escaping through telemetry while retaining useful provider timing.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs secret-free, low-cardinality runtime attestation and telemetry that remains subordinate to the evidence model.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT closely: preserve closed names/attributes, traceparent and clock validation plus capability denial; rename provider vocabulary and add run/Connector attestation ownership, quotas and sink-failure tests.
units.responsibilityConflict: Trace context proves correlation, not who authorized or is accountable for the underlying action; telemetry must not be promoted to Responsibility evidence by itself.

units.function: Small controller mapping lifecycle stop/unload and worker crash events to per-plugin HostServices disposer callbacks.
units.dependencyDirection: Depends only on lifecycle event subscription and a mutable pluginId-to-disposer Map; application wiring owns registration and replacement.
units.keyDataModels: Plugin worker crash/restart event, lifecycle stopped/unloaded payload and synchronous disposer registry.
units.lifecycle: Registers listeners, disposes on stop/crash, removes on unload, can dispose all and can detach listeners.
units.testAssessment: No focused tests were found. Throwing/async disposers, restart replacement, duplicate registration, teardown order and lifecycle path coverage are unverified.
units.designRationale: Avoid leaked event/session subscriptions across worker crashes and unloads without coupling HostServices to the lifecycle manager.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a durable runtime supervisor whose cancellation and cleanup convergence can be awaited, retried and observed across crashes and deployments.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE event-to-resource cleanup ownership, but implement async all-settled disposal with timeout, idempotency, generation fencing, restart replacement, failure evidence and focused lifecycle tests.
units.responsibilityConflict: Best-effort synchronous callbacks can silently leave resources active after a state change, and no evidence shows which actions, credentials, subscriptions or data leases were actually revoked.
evidence: no focused test found by repository search
